name: lunas-vps-automation
description: Automação do VPS Lunas Digital via API Hostinger

scripts.monitor: node -e "const LunasVPS = require('./lunas-vps-automation'); const auto = new LunasVPS(); auto.startMonitoring();"
scripts.deploy: node -e "const LunasVPS = require('./lunas-vps-automation'); const auto = new LunasVPS(); auto.deployApplication();"
scripts.backup: node -e "const LunasVPS = require('./lunas-vps-automation'); const auto = new LunasVPS(); auto.createAutomaticBackup();"
scripts.status: node -e "const LunasVPS = require('./lunas-vps-automation'); const auto = new LunasVPS(); auto.checkServicesStatus();"

author: Lunas Digital
